book.title: Nudge
book.author: Richard H. Thaler and Cass R. Sunstein

predict.question: Your sign-up form makes plan X the default. Six people simply keep the default; four others pick X with 50% probability. What share is expected to end up with X?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Nudge argues defaults can influence choices while alternatives remain available.
modelBoundary: Default X gives {A}%; default Y gives {B}%: only the six followers change. Following is assumed, not measured.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic cannot estimate how many real people follow a default.
